segments.an3.119:1.5: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco pāṇātipātī hoti…pe… samphappalāpī hoti.
segments.an3.119:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco micchāājīvo hoti, micchāājīvena jīvikaṃ [jīvitaṃ (syā. kaṃ. ka.)] kappeti.
segments.an3.119:3.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco micchādiṭṭhiko hoti viparītadassano –
segments.an3.119:3.3: ‘natthi dinnaṃ, natthi yiṭṭhaṃ…pe… ye imañca lokaṃ parañca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentī’ti.
segments.an3.119:4.5: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti…pe… samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti.
segments.an3.119:5.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco sammāājīvo hoti, sammāājīvena jīvikaṃ kappeti.
segments.an3.119:6.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco sammādiṭṭhiko hoti aviparītadassano –
segments.an3.119:6.3: ‘atthi dinnaṃ, atthi yiṭṭhaṃ…pe… ye imañca lokaṃ parañca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentī’ti.

lines: Chaṭṭhe chahi talehi samannāgato pāsakoti catūsu passesu cattāri talāni, dvīsu koṭīsu dve talānīti evaṃ chahi talehi samannāgato pāsakakīḷāpasutānaṃ maṇisadiso pāsakaviseso.
